summary.xhshow_signing_note: Pure Python algorithm generates correct x-s, x-t, x-s-common headers without Playwright/browser
summary.what_xhshow_replaces: Replaces Playwright-based JS execution for x-s/x-t signing. Still needs valid cookie (a1 + web_session) from a real login session.
summary.xhs_package_note: Works when provided sign=make_xhshow_sign_fn() bridge + valid cookies. Provides clean Python API for all XHS endpoints.
summary.recommendation: xhshow signing works perfectly as a standalone pure-Python replacement for Playwright JS execution. However, login is ABSOLUTELY REQUIRED - XHS server validates the a1 cookie server-side. With fake a1: all APIs return code -101 (no login info), all web pages redirect to captcha. Workflow: (1) obtain valid cookies via browser login (manual or automated), (2) use xhshow for signing (no Playwright needed), (3) make API calls with valid cookies + xhshow signatures.
summary.mediacrawler_patch_note: MediaCrawler applies a monkey-patch to fix GET request a3_hash calculation bug in xhshow (issue #104). Apply this patch when using xhshow standalone.
